page.title: Launch a token for free
page.description: Deploy a token on Base, Robinhood Chain or Arc with 100% of supply locked as Uniswap v4 liquidity. No platform fee. Gas only.
page.heading: Launch a token
page.intro: Pick a chain, fill this in, sign once, done. No platform fee. You only pay gas.

chain.heading: Chain
chain.note: same launch, same rules, on every chain
chain.notConfigured: Not configured here. Contract settings are missing in this environment.

blurb.base: Priced in ETH, TWIG or a Coinbase tokenized stock. Gas ≈ cents.
blurb.robinhood: Priced in USDG (dollars), ETH, GITLAWB or a Robinhood Stock Token. Gas ≈ cents.
blurb.arc: Priced in USDC (dollars). Gas is paid in USDC too: cents per trade, well under a dollar to launch.

quote.label: Quote asset
quote.paysDollars: Buyers pay with {symbol}; market cap and fees are in dollars.
quote.paysBrand: Buyers pay with {symbol}; fees are paid in {symbol}, or burned.
quote.pairTitle: Pair with {symbol} and your token carries the {symbol} badge everywhere on the site
quote.brandTwig: Your token carries the <badge></badge> badge on the launch list, trending, the activity feed, its page and its share card. TWIG is Twigpine's token on Base: a 1:1 wrapper of GITLAWB that anyone can wrap or unwrap any time, with no fee. No owner, no transfer restrictions. Name no beneficiary and the fees are burned as TWIG when collected. Priced at GITLAWB's price, from the Uniswap v4 WETH/GITLAWB pool on Base. <link>{site} ↗</link>
quote.brandGitlawb: Your token carries the <badge></badge> badge on the launch list, trending, the activity feed, its page and its share card. GITLAWB is Twigpine's token{bridged, select, yes {, bridged 1:1 from Base to Robinhood Chain over LayerZero} other {}}: an ordinary ERC-20, no transfer restrictions, no issuer switch. Name no beneficiary and the fees are burned as GITLAWB when collected. Price from the Uniswap v4 WETH/GITLAWB pool on Base. <link>{site} ↗</link>

stock.pick: Pick a stock to price the token in, or switch the quote.
stock.noneIssued: None of {symbol} has been issued yet, so nobody holds any and nobody can buy your token with it until Coinbase issues some. You can still launch now.
stock.showingMatches: Showing {shown} of {total} matches. Keep typing to narrow it down.
stock.showing: Showing {shown} of {total}. Search a ticker or a company name for the rest.

coinbase.pays: Buyers pay with a Coinbase tokenized stock; fees are paid in that stock.
coinbase.empty: No match. Search a ticker or a company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD or Netflix.
coinbase.issuer: Coinbase tokenized stocks are securities issued by Coinbase under Regulation S and are not offered to persons in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore or Switzerland. That is Coinbase's rule for the stock token, not ours. The pool itself is ordinary Uniswap v4.

robinhood.pays: Buyers pay with a Robinhood Stock Token; fees are paid in that stock.
robinhood.empty: No match. 194 Robinhood Stock Tokens are available, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, NVDA, SPY.
robinhood.issuer: Robinhood Stock Tokens are tokenised securities issued by Robinhood and are not offered to US persons. That is Robinhood's rule for the stock token, not ours. The pool itself is ordinary Uniswap v4.

token.name: Name

token.symbolInvalid: Symbol: use 1–10 English letters (A–Z) or digits (0–9).

price.heading: Starting market cap
price.supply: 1,000,000,000 supply · all of it in the pool
price.noUsd: {symbol} has no USD price here: enter the starting market cap in {symbol}.
price.opensAt: Opens at {cap} · {detail} fully diluted. The first {symbol} buys about {tokens} tokens, then the price climbs along the curve.
price.opensAtMillion: Opens at {cap} · {detail} fully diluted. The first 1M {symbol} buys about {tokens} tokens, then the price climbs along the curve.
price.capInvalid: Starting market cap must be a positive number.
price.brandUnpriced: {symbol} price unavailable right now: enter a custom starting market cap in {symbol}, or reload.

split.help: Shares in percent, up to two decimals, must total exactly 100%. A row with 0x…dEaD burns that share.

buy.heading: First buy
buy.note: a second transaction, right after the launch confirms
buy.capAfterLabel: Estimated market cap after your buy
buy.estimateHelp: Includes price impact and the pool fee; the exact amount is quoted on-chain right before the buy.
buy.notIssued: Nothing suggested: no {symbol} has been issued yet, so there is none to buy with. The launch stays free.
buy.onlyGas: Suggested {amount} {symbol}, but this wallet holds only gas. The launch stays free; you can buy on the token page later.
buy.notEnough: Suggested {amount} {symbol}, but this wallet does not hold enough {symbol} for the buy plus its gas. The launch stays free; you can buy on the token page later.
buy.noGas: Suggested {amount} {symbol}, but this wallet has no {native} left for the buy's gas. The launch stays free; you can buy on the token page later.
buy.unknownBalance: Could not read your balance, so nothing is suggested. The launch stays free; you can still type an amount.
buy.declined: No first buy. The launch stays free.
buy.declinedAgain: No first buy. The launch stays free. <again>Suggest {amount} {symbol} again</again>
buy.why: A token with no holders and no price move looks dead on every screener and sits under quiet launches on the home page. Your first buy opens the chart. Clear it and the launch stays free.
buy.slippage: Other traders can buy before you. First-buy slippage tolerance: {pct}%. Network gas and pool fees apply.

errors.amount: First buy: enter an amount in {symbol}, or leave it empty.
errors.balanceFailed: First buy: could not read your {symbol} balance. Retry, or clear the amount.
errors.shortWithGas: First buy: not enough {symbol} (leave a little for gas).
errors.short: First buy: not enough {symbol} in this wallet.
errors.gasFailed: First buy: could not read your {native} balance for gas. Retry, or clear the amount.
errors.gasChecking: First buy: checking your {native} balance for gas…
errors.gasShort: First buy: not enough {native} for gas (the launch, the approval and the buy each need a little {native}).

launch.heading: Launch
launch.deployDetail: no mint, no pause, no blacklist, no tax
launch.lockDetail: the position NFT lives in an ownerless locker, forever
launch.feesNamed: to the beneficiaries you name, claimable any time
launch.buyDetail: {amount} right after the launch confirms, with a second wallet prompt
launch.summary: One transaction on {chain}: deploys the token, creates the Uniswap v4 pool ({quote} / your token), locks 100% of the supply in it forever, and registers the fee routing. Cost: gas only, usually a few cents. Nothing is refundable and nothing can be edited afterwards.
launch.summaryBuy: One transaction on {chain}: deploys the token, creates the Uniswap v4 pool ({quote} / your token), locks 100% of the supply in it forever, and registers the fee routing. Cost: gas only, usually a few cents. Nothing is refundable and nothing can be edited afterwards. Then a second transaction buys {amount} of your token; if you reject it, the launch still stands.
launch.summaryBuyApproval: One transaction on {chain}: deploys the token, creates the Uniswap v4 pool ({quote} / your token), locks 100% of the supply in it forever, and registers the fee routing. Cost: gas only, usually a few cents. Nothing is refundable and nothing can be edited afterwards. Then a second transaction buys {amount} of your token (with a one-time approval the first time); if you reject it, the launch still stands.
